description: After host review, queue the exact previewed SMS to opted-in event guests and hosts. Requires preview_id plus its exact body as message and audienceSize as recipient_count; these must match the server snapshot. Host confirmation and event_updates_only are required. Current consent, permissions, expiry and allowance apply. Reuse the same preview after a lost response; queued is not delivered.

confirmed.description: True only after the host approves this exact SMS and audience.

event_updates_only.description: The host confirms this is only an update for this joined event, with no unrelated promotions.

message.description: The EXACT complete body returned by preview_sms_announcement, shown to the host for approval.

recipient_count.description: The exact audienceSize returned by that preview, shown to the host.

name: send_sms_announcement
title: Send Sms Announcement
